title: CRM 接入配置
description: 连接你的 AI 原生 CRM。首次连接将打开浏览器完成账号授权，授权后自动维持登录（有效期 30 天）。
description_en: Connect your AI-native CRM. A browser window opens for account authorization on first connect; the session then stays signed in for 30 days.
